_about: Tulvo's tidy script: runs after every capture take, and after a take that stopped, so rows a take adds do not pile up in Kestrel Studio (tools/capture/README.md, "Demo data: setup and tidy"). LOOK-ONLY PLACEHOLDER, 12 Nov 2026: it has no steps, so it does nothing. Nothing in Tulvo is deleted until the owner says yes.
_what_to_add_once_the_owner_approves: 1. For each record a capture adds (for example the "Morrowby Coffee" lead), the steps that remove it through Tulvo itself: open the board, right-click or open the row's menu, choose Delete, confirm ({"right-click": "Morrowby Coffee"}, {"click": "Delete"}, {"click": "Delete", "in": "Delete record"}). The Tulvo connector cannot delete, so this is the way.
2. Remove only what the setup script or the capture added, found by its made-up name. Never a step that deletes a whole board, a page or anything the brand did not add for the video.
3. End with a wait that proves it is gone ({"wait for": "Morrowby Coffee", "gone": true}), so a second take starts from the same board.
4. Test it with a dry run, then look at Kestrel Studio by hand.
